lines.text: Ephraim mixes with the nations and is an unturned cake, and foreigners consume his strength without his noticing.
Israel's arrogance testifies against them, and Ephraim becomes like a senseless dove calling out to Egypt, then turning to Babylon.
The LORD says He will spread His net over them and bring them down like birds of the air.
The people speak lies against the LORD, and they slash themselves for silver and gold but turn away from Him.
Though the LORD strengthened their arms, they plot evil, and their leaders will fall by the sword.
